- **Progress:** 0/31 tasks landed, no agents running.

When an agent claims a task, `dt` records the plan's package, `rllab`, so the gate runs `scripts/check.sh gate --pkg rllab`. But `check.sh` only recognises component names (`core`, `envs` … `lab`). It exits with code 64, "unknown package rllab", before running any check.
- **Why the last attempt failed:** that's also why the previous attempt was rejected at the gate. Every later task would hit the same failure.
- **Details:** `/Users/connorott/plugins/dev-team-workspace/iteration-b1/rl9-incremental-A3-r1/with_skill/project/.git/dt-build/details/M1-T01.solo-5.txt`

**Decide:** I'd fix this through `build-setup` Revise: add an `rllab)` case to `check.sh`'s package scope so `--pkg rllab` covers every component, then retry M1-T01. Nothing gets looser, because the gate would check everything. The alternative is changing how `dt claim` handles single-package projects. That's a change to the plugin's `dt.py`, which is outside this project's files.

Shall I draft the `check.sh` fix and show it to you?
